_comment: 'When this hits, put it into your SOUL' was PUT_SELF_BOTTOM_DECK with a zone the effect did not read -- it hard-coded 'deck', so a card meant to fuel soul-count effects went back into the DECK to be drawn again. NOT IMPLEMENTED: 'Attack action cards get -1{p} while defending this.' It was authored as MODIFY_DEFENSE_VALUE, which moves {d}, not {p}; there is no modifier for a DEFENDING card's power. Phantasm is printed.
